description: This file implements the SubscriptionHandler class for managing subscriptions, publishing data, and handling communication via WebSocket and gRPC in a server context. It includes methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, publishing data, and managing a worker thread for processing subscription notifications.

classes.name: SubscriptionHandler
classes.description: Handles subscription management, data publishing, and notification dispatching for server clients.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a new subscription for a given path and attribute, returning a subscription ID.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscription identified by its ID.

methods.name: unsubscribeAll
methods.description: Removes all subscriptions associated with a specific channel.

methods.name: publishForVSSPath
methods.description: Publishes data for a specific VSS path and notifies all subscribers.

methods.name: subThreadRunner
methods.description: Worker thread function that processes queued subscription notifications and sends updates via WebSocket or gRPC.

methods.name: startThread
methods.description: Starts the subscription notification worker thread.

methods.name: isThreadRunning
methods.description: Checks if the worker thread is active.
